stem.text: Two projectiles, X and Y, are fired into the air from the same place on level ground and reach the same maximum height, as shown.

stem.alt: Diagram of two projectile paths above a horizontal ground line: a vertical path labelled path of X and a curved path labelled path of Y, with the ground labelled.

stem.text: Projectile X is fired vertically upwards and projectile Y is fired at an angle to the horizontal.

A.text: X and Y are at rest at their maximum heights.

B.text: X and Y are fired with the same speed.

C.text: X and Y take the same time to return to the ground.

D.text: X and Y travel the same distance.
